query: SELECT blob_digest AS "blob_digest!" FROM ( SELECT dmb.blob_digest FROM docker_manifest_blobs dmb JOIN docker_manifests dm ON dm.id = dmb.manifest_id WHERE dm.package_repository_id = $1 AND dmb.blob_digest = ANY($2) UNION SELECT blob_digest FROM docker_repository_blobs WHERE package_repository_id = $1 AND blob_digest = ANY($2) ) reachable
